name: DIVA ~Utahime no Yuuwaku~
source:
A beautiful singer who you fell in love with at first sight (and sound) fulfills your longtime fantasy of a private serenade in a secret karaoke room for two.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ102358.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: 你对一位美丽歌手一见倾心，也为她的歌声着迷。她在一间只容得下两人的秘密卡拉OK包厢里，为你献唱私人的小夜曲，满足了你长久以来的幻想。[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ102358.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
